description: Pay with x402 (USDC on Base, $1 to $1,000) and get an agent key that holds that amount as its bounty balance, with no registration and no person. Put the x402 payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (or the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE HTTP header); without one the result is the payment terms as an error result with structuredContent, and a paid result carries _meta["x402/payment-response"]. With agent_key the amount is added to that key's balance instead. A new key needs a payment-identifier id in the payment's extensions: 32 to 128 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, random (for example 16 random bytes in hex), because it is the key's only recovery secret: the key is shown once, and only a retry with that same id shows it again, within 24 hours of issue. It pays bounties from this balance on its own within its spending limits.

agent_key.description: Optional: add the amount to this key's balance instead of buying a new key.

handle.description: Optional public handle for a new key. Leave it out to get one.
